berberskog: berberski — barber's; gen. case masc. sg.
bojiš: bojati se — to fear; 2nd pers. sg.
brijanje: brijati — to shave; Donje Brijanje — name of the village («Donje Brijanje»)
brijao: brijati — to shave; past masc. sg.
car: handsome fellow, good for you (lit. king)
da: conjunction: that, so that; da + verb = infinitive («da vidim» — to see); also «yes»
doba: u bilo koje doba — at any time
dobijao: dobijati — to receive; past masc. sg.
dobro: dobro veče — good evening; dobro je što — good thing that
dozove: dozvati — to call over; 3rd pers. sg.
ga: short form of njega; «ili ti ga» — «or, in other words» (colloquial)
gde: gde si — hi, how are you (colloquial)
gradu: grad; loc. case: po gradu — around the city
i: conjunction; before the word — «and, also, even»
ima: imati — to have; ima = «there is, there exists»
iskaže: iskazati — to tell, to declare; 3rd pers. sg.
ispovedao: ispovediti — to confess; past masc. sg.
istrgne: istrgnuti — to pull out; 3rd pers. sg.
iziđe: izići — to come out; past 3rd pers. sg.
išao: ići; past, masc.: ići na sigurno — to play it safe
je: biti — to be, 3rd pers. sg.; auxiliary verb past; je l' — «really, or what»
kazao: kazati — to say; past masc. sg.
kazivao: kazivati — to tell; past masc. sg.
kažem: kazati — to say; 1st pers. sg.; da kažem — let's say
koje: koji — which; neut. sg. or acc. pl.
kome: koji; loc. case: u kome živim — in which I live
kozje: kozji — goat's; nom. case neut. pl.
kući: kuća — house; idemo kući — we're driving home
mene: ja; acc./gen. case: po mene — after me
meni: full form dat. case of ja
mi: mi — we; short form «me» (potreban mi je — I need)
momka: momak — lad, young man; acc. case sg.
može: moći — to be able; 3rd pers. sg.; «može» — «all right, it's okay»
na: preposition: na jugu — in the south, na Instagram — in Instagram
narasla: narasti — to grow; past fem. sg.
nećeš: you won't; you don't want to
neg. form of hteti; 2nd pers. sg.
neću: I won't; I don't want to
neg. form of hteti; 1st pers. sg.
ni: nije čak ni selo — this is not even a village
nije: negation of je: nije selo — this is not a village
nikla: nići — to sprout; past fem. sg.
ništa: at the beginning of a sentence — «well then, anyway»
njega: on — he; gen./acc. case: pored njega — past him
njim: on — he; s njim — with him
obrijao: obrijati — to shave; past masc. sg.
od: preposition + gen. case: jedno od naselja — one of the settlements
odlaknulo: odlaknuti — to feel relieved; past neut. sg.
odseku: odseći — to cut off; 3rd pers. pl.
oglasio: oglasiti — to announce; past masc. sg.
onaki: onakav — such; nom. case masc. sg.
opazi: opaziti — to notice; past 3rd pers. sg.
otide: otići — to go away; 3rd pers. sg.
pa: particle at the start of a line — «well»; conjunction — «and, therefore»
po: po mraku — in the dark; po jedan — one by one; dva i po — two and a half
posekao: poseći — to cut down; past masc. sg.
poseče: poseći — to cut down; 3rd pers. sg.
počne: početi; 3rd pers. sg.: neka počne — let it begin
pođe: poći — to go; past 3rd pers. sg.
prepadne: prepasti se — to get frightened; 3rd pers. sg.
pruta: prut — twig, rod; gen. case sg.
puta: put — road, way; gen. case: preko puta — opposite, across the road
razglasi: razglasiti se — to spread (news); 3rd pers. sg.
red: noun masc.; doći na red — to reach (about the queue)
redu: red — row, queue; na redu — next in line
sad: = sada; e sad — well then, so
sam: biti, 1st pers. sg.: rekao sam — I said; also «myself»: sam sebi — to oneself
se: reflexive particle: slikamo se — we take photos of ourselves
sedne: sesti — to sit down; 3rd pers. sg.
si: biti, 2nd pers. sg.; gde si — hi, how are you (colloquial)
sme: smeti — to dare, to have the right; 3rd pers. sg. (ne sme — not allowed)
smiri: smiriti se — to calm down; 3rd pers. sg.
sobom: reflexive pronoun; instr. case: sa sobom — with oneself
su: biti, 3rd pers. pl.: sela su — villages — this…
sve: sav — all; neut. sg. or pl.
sviralu: svirala — pipe, flute; acc. case sg.
ti: pronoun «you»; short form «you (dat.)» (gde ti je telefon — where is your phone)
toga: to; gen. case: biće toga još — there will be more of that
treće: treći — third; acc. case neut. sg.
u: preposition: + loc. case — where, + acc. case — where to
uveri: uveriti se — to make sure; 3rd pers. sg.
učini: učiniti se — to seem; past 3rd pers. sg.
video: noun masc. «video»; also videti — to see, past, masc.
vraćao: vraćati se — to return; past, masc.
za: preposition: za to — for this; skretanje za — turn onto
zagrne: zagrnuti — to cover over; 3rd pers. sg.
zapita: zapitati — to ask; past 3rd pers. sg.
zapitao: zapitati — to ask; past masc. sg.
zapovedi: zapovediti — to order; 3rd pers. sg. past
zavuče: zavući — to thrust in; 3rd pers. sg.
što: conjunction «what»; colloquial question «of what, why» (što si se sredio?)
